title: ChangesetRequest
description: Parameters of changeset.load. There is no branch, commit or range here: the application reviews the working tree against HEAD and nothing else.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute path to the worktree root, as returned by repository.open.

includeUntracked.description: Whether to include untracked files that are not gitignored. Defaults to true because an AI-generated change routinely adds brand-new files, and dropping them would silently lose part of the change. Gitignored files are excluded either way.
